/-!
R4 item (i) of `designs/2026-11-12-kcheck-model-first.md`: a mutual block of
three functions, each structurally recursive on one shared `Nat` counter.
`whnf` and `conv` read a token before they call into the block; `infer`
reads none and descends its term at an unchanged cursor. The advice is a
token list and a position.
-/

inductive Tok where
  | core
  | stop
  | same
  | both
  | inspect

inductive Tm where
  | lit : Nat → Tm
  | succ : Tm → Tm
  | pair : Tm → Tm → Tm

inductive Refusal where
  | depth
  | noToken : Nat → Refusal
  | shape : Nat → Refusal
  | differ : Nat → Refusal

def Refusal.show : Refusal → String
  | .depth => "depth"
  | .noToken p => s!"no token at {p}"
  | .shape p => s!"step at {p} does not apply"
  | .differ p => s!"terms differ at {p}"

def tokAt : List Tok → Nat → Option Tok
  | [], _ => none
  | t :: _, 0 => some t
  | _ :: ts, n + 1 => tokAt ts n

def Tm.beq : Tm → Tm → Bool
  | .lit m, .lit n => m == n
  | .succ a, .succ b => Tm.beq a b
  | .pair a b, .pair c d => Tm.beq a c && Tm.beq b d
  | _, _ => false

mutual
/-- Head reduction, one token per step: `core` contracts `succ (lit n)`. -/
def whnf : Nat → Tm → List Tok → Nat → Except Refusal (Tm × Nat)
  | 0, _, _, _ => .error .depth
  | fuel + 1, t, toks, pos =>
    match tokAt toks pos with
    | some .inspect =>
      match infer fuel t toks (pos + 1) with
      | .ok (_, p) => .ok (t, p)
      | .error e => .error e
    | some .stop => .ok (t, pos + 1)
    | some .core =>
      match t with
      | .succ (.lit n) => whnf fuel (.lit (n + 1)) toks (pos + 1)
      | .succ a =>
        match whnf fuel a toks (pos + 1) with
        | .ok (a', p) => whnf fuel (.succ a') toks p
        | .error e => .error e
      | _ => .error (.shape pos)
    | some _ => .error (.shape pos)
    | none => .error (.noToken pos)

/-- Conversion: `same` compares as they are, `both` reduces both sides. -/
def conv : Nat → Tm → Tm → List Tok → Nat → Except Refusal Nat
  | 0, _, _, _, _ => .error .depth
  | fuel + 1, a, b, toks, pos =>
    match tokAt toks pos with
    | some .same => if Tm.beq a b then .ok (pos + 1) else .error (.differ pos)
    | some .both =>
      match whnf fuel a toks (pos + 1) with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok (a', p) =>
        match whnf fuel b toks p with
        | .error e => .error e
        | .ok (b', q) => conv fuel a' b' toks q
    | some _ => .error (.shape pos)
    | none => .error (.noToken pos)

/-- Size of a term; reads no token and keeps the cursor. -/
def infer : Nat → Tm → List Tok → Nat → Except Refusal (Nat × Nat)
  | 0, _, _, _ => .error .depth
  | fuel + 1, t, toks, pos =>
    match t with
    | .lit _ => .ok (1, pos)
    | .succ a =>
      match conv fuel a a toks pos with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok _ =>
        match infer fuel a toks pos with
        | .ok (n, q) => .ok (n + 1, q)
        | .error e => .error e
    | .pair a b =>
      match infer fuel a toks pos with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok (m, p) =>
        match infer fuel b toks p with
        | .error e => .error e
        | .ok (n, q) => .ok (m + n + 1, q)
end

def verdict (name : String) (r : Except Refusal Nat) : String :=
  match r with
  | .ok p => s!"{name}: ACCEPT cursor={p}"
  | .error e => s!"{name}: REFUSE {e.show}"

def main : IO Unit := do
  let two := Tm.succ (.succ (.lit 0))
  let adv : List Tok := [.both, .core, .core, .stop, .core, .stop, .stop, .same]
  IO.println (verdict "conv-both" (conv 10 two (.lit 2) adv 0))
  IO.println (verdict "conv-same" (conv 10 (.lit 2) (.lit 2) [.same] 0))
  IO.println (verdict "conv-differ" (conv 10 two (.lit 3) adv 0))
  IO.println (verdict "conv-truncated" (conv 10 two (.lit 2) [.both, .core] 0))
  IO.println (verdict "conv-wrong-token" (conv 10 two (.lit 2) [.core] 0))
  IO.println (verdict "conv-depth" (conv 2 two (.lit 2) adv 0))
  match infer 10 (.pair two (.lit 5)) [] 7 with
  | .ok (n, p) => IO.println s!"infer: size={n} cursor={p}"
  | .error e => IO.println s!"infer: REFUSE {e.show}"

  match whnf 20 (.succ (.lit 2)) [.inspect, .both, .stop, .stop, .same] 0 with
  | .ok (_, p) => IO.println s!"cycle: ACCEPT cursor={p}"
  | .error e => IO.println s!"cycle: REFUSE {e.show}"

  match whnf 20 (.succ (.lit 2)) [.inspect] 0 with
  | .ok (_, p) => IO.println s!"cycle-truncated: ACCEPT cursor={p}"
  | .error e => IO.println s!"cycle-truncated: REFUSE {e.show}"
  match whnf 2 (.succ (.lit 2)) [.inspect, .both, .stop, .stop, .same] 0 with
  | .ok (_, p) => IO.println s!"cycle-depth: ACCEPT cursor={p}"
  | .error e => IO.println s!"cycle-depth: REFUSE {e.show}"

/-!
R4 item (ix), from the design's Revision 2: a list-iterating member of the
block (the walk of 2.3.1). At `fuel + 1` it handles one `(argument, label)`
pair, calls another member (`conv`) at `fuel`, and calls itself at `fuel` on
the rest, so every member recurses on the shared counter, not on the list.
-/

inductive Tok where
  | core
  | stop
  | same
  | both
  | inspect

inductive Tm where
  | lit : Nat → Tm
  | succ : Tm → Tm

inductive Refusal where
  | depth
  | noToken : Nat → Refusal
  | shape : Nat → Refusal
  | differ : Nat → Refusal

def Refusal.show : Refusal → String
  | .depth => "depth"
  | .noToken p => s!"no token at {p}"
  | .shape p => s!"step at {p} does not apply"
  | .differ p => s!"terms differ at {p}"

def tokAt : List Tok → Nat → Option Tok
  | [], _ => none
  | t :: _, 0 => some t
  | _ :: ts, n + 1 => tokAt ts n

def Tm.beq : Tm → Tm → Bool
  | .lit m, .lit n => m == n
  | .succ a, .succ b => Tm.beq a b
  | _, _ => false

mutual
def whnf : Nat → Tm → List Tok → Nat → Except Refusal (Tm × Nat)
  | 0, _, _, _ => .error .depth
  | fuel + 1, t, toks, pos =>
    match tokAt toks pos with
    | some .inspect =>
      match walk fuel [(t, t)] toks (pos + 1) with
      | .ok p => .ok (t, p)
      | .error e => .error e
    | some .stop => .ok (t, pos + 1)
    | some .core =>
      match t with
      | .succ (.lit n) => whnf fuel (.lit (n + 1)) toks (pos + 1)
      | _ => .error (.shape pos)
    | some _ => .error (.shape pos)
    | none => .error (.noToken pos)
def conv : Nat → Tm → Tm → List Tok → Nat → Except Refusal Nat
  | 0, _, _, _, _ => .error .depth
  | fuel + 1, a, b, toks, pos =>
    match tokAt toks pos with
    | some .same => if Tm.beq a b then .ok (pos + 1) else .error (.differ pos)
    | some .both =>
      match whnf fuel a toks (pos + 1) with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok (a', p) =>
        match whnf fuel b toks p with
        | .error e => .error e
        | .ok (b', q) => conv fuel a' b' toks q
    | some _ => .error (.shape pos)
    | none => .error (.noToken pos)
/-- Check every argument against its label, one pair per call. -/
def walk : Nat → List (Tm × Tm) → List Tok → Nat → Except Refusal Nat
  | 0, _, _, _ => .error .depth
  | _ + 1, [], _, pos => .ok pos
  | fuel + 1, (arg, label) :: rest, toks, pos =>
    match conv fuel arg label toks pos with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok p => walk fuel rest toks p
end

def verdict (name : String) (r : Except Refusal Nat) : String :=
  match r with
  | .ok p => s!"{name}: ACCEPT cursor={p}"
  | .error e => s!"{name}: REFUSE {e.show}"

def main : IO Unit := do
  let pairs : List (Tm × Tm) := [(.lit 3, .lit 3), (.succ (.lit 1), .lit 2), (.lit 0, .lit 0)]
  let adv : List Tok := [.same, .both, .core, .stop, .stop, .same, .same]
  IO.println (verdict "walk-three" (walk 10 pairs adv 0))
  IO.println (verdict "walk-empty" (walk 1 [] [] 4))
  IO.println (verdict "walk-bad-label" (walk 10 [(.lit 3, .lit 3), (.succ (.lit 1), .lit 5)] adv 0))
  IO.println (verdict "walk-depth" (walk 3 pairs adv 0))

  match whnf 20 (.lit 2) [.inspect, .both, .stop, .stop, .same] 0 with
  | .ok (_, p) => IO.println s!"cycle: ACCEPT cursor={p}"
  | .error e => IO.println s!"cycle: REFUSE {e.show}"

  match whnf 20 (.lit 2) [.inspect] 0 with
  | .ok (_, p) => IO.println s!"cycle-truncated: ACCEPT cursor={p}"
  | .error e => IO.println s!"cycle-truncated: REFUSE {e.show}"
  match whnf 2 (.lit 2) [.inspect, .both, .stop, .stop, .same] 0 with
  | .ok (_, p) => IO.println s!"cycle-depth: ACCEPT cursor={p}"
  | .error e => IO.println s!"cycle-depth: REFUSE {e.show}"

/-!
R4 item (x), from the design's Revision 2: a report accumulator threaded
through every member's `Except` result. Each member takes the report so far
and returns it extended; the head loop carries it through 10⁶ self tail
calls and must still compile to a loop.
-/

inductive Tm where
  | lit : Nat → Tm
  | succ : Tm → Tm

/-- The report: head steps taken and the largest literal reached. -/
structure Report where
  steps : Nat
  maxLit : Nat

def Report.note (r : Report) (k : Nat) : Report :=
  { steps := r.steps + 1, maxLit := if k > r.maxLit then k else r.maxLit }

def Tm.beq : Tm → Tm → Bool
  | .lit m, .lit n => m == n
  | .succ a, .succ b => Tm.beq a b
  | _, _ => false

mutual
/-- Head loop: the advice is `core` below `n`, then `stop`. -/
def whnf : Nat → Nat → Tm → Nat → Report → Except String (Tm × Nat × Report)
  | 0, _, _, _, _ => .error "depth"
  | fuel + 1, n, t, pos, rep =>
    if pos < n then
      match t with
      | .lit k => whnf fuel n (.lit (k + 1)) (pos + 1) (rep.note (k + 1))
      | .succ a =>
        match walk fuel n [(a, a)] (pos + 1) (rep.note 0) with
        | .error e => .error e
        | .ok (p, rep') => whnf fuel n a p rep' 
    else .ok (t, pos, rep)
termination_by structural fuel _ _ _ _ => fuel
def conv : Nat → Nat → Tm → Tm → Nat → Report → Except String (Nat × Report)
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _ => .error "depth"
  | fuel + 1, n, a, b, pos, rep =>
    match whnf fuel n a pos rep with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok (a', p, rep') =>
      if Tm.beq a' b then .ok (p, rep') else .error "sides differ"
termination_by structural fuel _ _ _ _ _ => fuel
def walk : Nat → Nat → List (Tm × Tm) → Nat → Report → Except String (Nat × Report)
  | 0, _, _, _, _ => .error "depth"
  | _ + 1, _, [], pos, rep => .ok (pos, rep)
  | fuel + 1, n, (a, b) :: rest, pos, rep =>
    match conv fuel n a b pos rep with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok (p, rep') => walk fuel n rest p rep'
termination_by structural fuel _ _ _ _ => fuel
end

def verdict (name : String) (r : Except String (Nat × Report)) : String :=
  match r with
  | .ok (p, rep) => s!"{name}: ACCEPT cursor={p} steps={rep.steps} max={rep.maxLit}"
  | .error e => s!"{name}: REFUSE {e}"

def main : IO Unit := do
  let start : Report := { steps := 0, maxLit := 0 }
  IO.println (verdict "million-steps" (conv 1000002 1000000 (.lit 0) (.lit 1000000) 0 start))
  IO.println (verdict "walk" (walk 10 3 [(.succ (.succ (.lit 7)), .lit 8), (.lit 9, .lit 9)] 0 start))
  IO.println (verdict "differ" (conv 10 2 (.lit 0) (.lit 3) 0 start))
  IO.println (verdict "depth" (conv 1000000 1000000 (.lit 0) (.lit 1000000) 0 start))

  match whnf 20 1 (.succ (.lit 2)) 0 start with
  | .ok (_, p, rep) => IO.println (verdict "cycle" (.ok (p, rep)))
  | .error e => IO.println (verdict "cycle" (.error e))
  match whnf 2 1 (.succ (.lit 2)) 0 start with
  | .ok (_, p, rep) => IO.println (verdict "cycle-depth" (.ok (p, rep)))
  | .error e => IO.println (verdict "cycle-depth" (.error e))
